raw_html: [[Maiming#Greater Maiming|Greater Maiming]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Maiming#Greater Maiming|Greater Maiming]]:''' This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 8 to 48, x3 - 12 to 72, x4 - 16 to 96.
